programmes.d: An antique teacup decorated with swappers' ivy lets the user borrow youth and talent from a victim by taking their life.
Distant cousins Ryan Dallion and Micki Foster have inherited an antique shop from Uncle Lewis Vendredi. They realize that some of the antiques they sold were also cursed.
A doctor has obtained the cursed scalpel used by Jack the Ripper and discovers he can use it to kill one victim and miraculously heal one of his patients.
A magician creates a new death-defying act using a pair of cursed antique magic boxes created by the famous magician Houdini. Anyone placed in one box can survive any danger.
A cursed set of boxing gloves makes their owner unbeatable in the ring...while his shadow goes out and beats an innocent to death.
Micki and Ryan throw a Halloween party at the shop to meet the neighbours, but two visitors inadvertently resurrect Uncle Vendredi's spirit.
A gardener's assistant gets hold of a cursed mulcher. The wealthier and more valuable the person you feed into it, the more money that comes out.
An old and embittered comic book writer, Jay Star, gets hold of a cursed comic book that allows him to transform into Ferrus the Invincible.
One of the local farmers uses a cursed scarecrow. She must pin the pictures of three victims on the scarecrow's chest. When it claims all three victims, the result is a good harvest.
Jack is asked by a friend to investigate a faith healer who uses a cursed glove to heal one person...by transferring their ills magnified tenfold to another victim.
Jack and Ryan recover a cursed antique and take it to the shop before leaving, but its owners come looking for it and Micki must fend for herself.
The trio seeks a cursed brooch that transforms its wearer into a vampire... and allows them to travel through time.
A homely high schooler gets hold of a cursed compact which forces anyone hit by its reflected light to fall in love with her but die for love.
Tommy Chow gets hold of a set of tattoo needles. He tattoos an innocent victim, and the tattoo then comes to gory life and kills the victim. In return, Tommy gets good luck.
An innocent man is condemned to the electric chair but manages to survive. Embittered, the man buys the electric chair from Lewis Vendredi.
A man discovers a cursed trefinator in a museum warehouse: a device that transfers intelligence, the man uses it to make himself intelligent.
A cursed quilt, which allows the person underneath it to dream their enemies to death, finds its way into an Amish-like Penitente community.
Jack and Micki return to the religious community to discover that Reverend Josiah, Ryan's future father-in-law, is using it to destroy his enemies in their dreams.
Winston Knight, a TV anchorman, gains great fame because a serial killer, the Machete Killer, will only contact him.
Ryan's father Ray, a small-time inventor, rolls into town and announces that he's achieved great financial success and is planning to finally marry.

Tracking a cursed foghorn, Micki & Ryan arrive at an isolated community. Initially unbeknownst to them, the local lighthouse keeper is using the foghorn to summon up the ghost of pirate Angus MacBride
An old boyfriend of Micki's, Tim Ayres, shows up in town, and immediately begins acting suspiciously. Ryan, somewhat jealous, believes that Ayres is working with local counterfeiters.
Two desperate parents were given an antique cradle by a sympathetic Lewis Vendredi. The cradle belonged to a female passenger aboard the Titanic.
A mysterious messenger brings a Coptic urn to the store, which bursts open, the gas from the jar puts Micki & Ryan into a trance where they are forced to relive their most horrifying moments.

A low-life gets hold of a cursed statue that allows him to turn women into loving worshippers who fall at his feet. However, he is compelled to kill them in hideous ways once he has his way with them.
The cousins and Jack track an antique quill pen to a monastery famed for its mysterious prophecies. The pen can be used to make anything written with it come true.
An antique teacup decorated with swappers' ivy lets the user borrow youth and talent from a victim by taking their life.
